تقتصدن (form VIII)
# تَقْتَصِدْنَ (taqtaṣidna) /taq.ta.sˤid.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَصَدَ (iqtaṣada)
# تُقْتَصَدْنَ (tuqtaṣadna) /tuq.ta.sˤad.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَصَدَ (iqtaṣada)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
